highLevelGoal: Build Orca-Strator into a Windows-first autonomous multi-repository AI development orchestrator according to the locked architecture and roadmap.

checkpoint.summary: Pre-implementation hardening is complete. V1 is now consistently main-only with no repository branch field; static repository configuration is separated from future run state; the Git dispatch/result/Sol-control protocol has versioned JSON Schemas; Windows/WSL line-ending and local-secret/runtime ignore baselines are seeded; Playwright headed setup and headless automation share an explicit exclusive persistent-profile lock; and Change 001 now establishes a same-origin web seam where the controller serves the built SPA plus REST/WebSocket while Vite proxies the same relative routes in development. This removes the latent phone-localhost problem and lets future Tailscale Serve proxy one loopback Orca origin without a second API client or wildcard CORS.
